d: Company Description BAHRAIN ELECTRICAL is an electrical services company headquartered in Manama, Bahrain, and operates from Building no. 0057, Road no. 338. The company serves residential, commercial, and industrial clients with a range of electrical installation and maintenance services. Team members work closely with customers to deliver reliable, safe, and compliant electrical solutions. The organization values technical expertise, quality workmanship, and adherence to local regulations and standards. Joining BAHRAIN ELECTRICAL offers the opportunity to contribute to essential infrastructure and grow in a hands-on technical environment.

Role Description The Electrician will perform day-to-day electrical tasks, including installation, maintenance, and repair of electrical systems and equipment. Responsibilities include reading and interpreting electrical drawings, wiring and connecting components, diagnosing faults, and carrying out troubleshooting to ensure safe and efficient operation. The role involves inspecting systems for compliance with safety standards, performing preventive maintenance, and responding to service requests on-site. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Southern Governorate, Bahrain, requiring regular collaboration with supervisors, colleagues, and clients to complete projects on schedule and to quality standards.
q: li
Candidates should possess strong practical skills in electricity and electrical work, including installation, wiring, and safe operation of electrical systems.
li
Candidates should possess skills in maintenance & repair and troubleshooting to diagnose issues and perform corrective actions on electrical equipment and infrastructure.
li
Candidates should possess foundational knowledge of electrical engineering principles to understand system design, load calculations, and applicable standards.
li
Candidates should possess awareness of safety regulations, use of appropriate tools and PPE, and adherence to local electrical codes and best practices.
li
Candidates should possess relevant technical education or vocational training in electrical trades, along with prior experience as an electrician or in a similar role.
li
Candidates should possess good communication skills, the ability to follow instructions and technical drawings, and the capacity to work independently and as part of a team.

d: Benefits: Medical insurance and annual flight tickets for self and family, plus an annual discretionary bonus/incentive
